info.title: OPKSSH API
info.description: Connect to hosts with short-lived OpenPubkey SSH certificates after signing in with your identity provider.

bearerAuth.description: Session token sent in the Authorization header as Bearer and the token.

cookieAuth.name: jwt
cookieAuth.description: Session JWT cookie set at sign-in. When present, it takes precedence over the Authorization header.

apiKeyAuth.description: API key sent in the Authorization header as Bearer and the key, which starts with tmx_. It acts as the key owner and cannot act as anyone else.

get.summary: Get the cached OPKSSH certificate status for a host
get.description: Whether the current user has a valid cached certificate for this host, and when it expires.

404.description: Host not found or not accessible.

delete.summary: Forget the cached OPKSSH certificate for a host
delete.description: The next connection to the host asks for a browser sign-in again.

200.description: Certificate removed, or there was none.

404.description: Host not found or not accessible.

get.summary: Proxy the OPKSSH provider chooser page and its resources
get.description: Public. Serves OPKSSH's local chooser for one sign-in, rewriting its URLs to this path. Any subpath is proxied too.

302.description: Redirect to the identity provider or the callback listener.

502.description: OPKSSH did not answer as expected.

get.summary: OAuth callback from the identity provider for an OPKSSH sign-in
get.description: Public. The redirect URI registered with the identity provider. Finds the sign-in by OAuth state or the opkssh_request_id cookie and forwards to its proxied callback listener.

302.description: Forwarded to the sign-in's callback listener.

503.description: OPKSSH's callback listener is not ready yet.

get.summary: Proxy OPKSSH's local callback listener for one sign-in
get.description: Public. Forwards to OPKSSH's login-callback listener, which prints the key and certificate once the code exchange succeeds. Any subpath is proxied too.
